about: For every signal scored on a figure: how the 300 projects are spread, the thresholds as written, and the thresholds history would give (better half scores 1, next 30% score 2, next 15% score 3, worst 5% score 4). Flagged = the written rule puts 60% or more of the projects in one score. Rules that follow a regulatory limit are never flagged.
